key.name: clock-position
key.summary: Where the clock sits in the top bar
key.description: Moving the clock out of the centre gives the right side room for tray icons, so their labels don't get cut off.

key.name: hidden-items
key.description: Stable item names as listed in known-items: "tray:ID" for tray icons (the app's StatusNotifierItem ID, or its window class for old-style tray icons), otherwise the panel role, such as an extension's UUID.

key.name: known-items
key.description: Written by the extension: item name to display label. The preferences window lists these so you can pick what to hide.
